entry.title: fix(catalog): align attachment flag with modalities for kimi-k2.5 and…
entry.content:
fix(catalog): align attachment flag with modalities for kimi-k2.5 and grok-code (#5793)

* fix(moonshotai): align kimi-k2.5 attachment flag with its own modalities

The provider entry sets attachment=false while its [modalities] declares
image+video input, its lab entry (models/moonshotai/kimi-k2.5.toml) sets
attachment=true, and Moonshot's official model list documents kimi-k2.5 as
supporting 'visual and text input'. Per the catalog convention (attachment
derived from non-text input modalities) and the provider-file override-only
rule, attachment must be true.

Consumers (e.g. OpenCode) read this flag to gate image attachments; the
current value blocks image input for a vision-capable model (see
anomalyco/opencode#23427).

* fix(opencode): disable attachment flag for text-only grok-code

grok-code (xAI Grok Code Fast 1) accepts text input only, but its entry
sets attachment=true. Per the catalog's derivation convention (attachment
from non-text input modalities) the flag must be false; the current value
makes consumers offer attachment flows that cannot succeed. Entry is
already status=deprecated; no other fields touched.

---------

Co-authored-by: jarvislee90s-dot <266288279+jarvislee90s-dot@users.noreply.github.com>

entry.title: feat(coralbricks): add GLM 5.3, remove deprecated GLM 5.2 (#5902)
entry.content:
feat(coralbricks): add GLM 5.3, remove deprecated GLM 5.2 (#5902)

* feat(coralbricks): add GLM 5.3 (glm-5.3-fp4)

New model live on the CoralBricks gateway: 1M context, $1.12/M in,
$4.40/M out, cached input free (cache_read=0), reasoning toggle +
effort. Verified in the live /v1/models and a chat smoke.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(coralbricks): align GLM 5.3 reasoning_options to the lab baseline

Bot review: GLM-5.3 always reasons with effort low|high|max (per the
first-party zhipuai/zai entries and our own models.json routing). Drop
the copied-from-5.2 toggle + minimal/medium levels, and drop the
redundant reasoning=true (inherited from base_model zhipuai/glm-5.3).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(coralbricks): remove GLM 5.2 (deprecated on prod)

glm-5.2-fp4 is deprecated in favor of GLM 5.3 (dropped from the prod tier
on the CoralBricks gateway; returns 404 model_not_public). Remove its
model entry. Provider now lists glm-5.3-fp4, kimi-k3, gpt-oss-120b.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
